title: Universal Provenance Token: Every Creation as Auto-Stamped NFT
subtitle: Game skins, car deeds, art prints — all the same token, all in one pocketbook

chains_to: p·001 (Content Sovereignty via Null Tenant Layer)
abstract: A system and method for automatic provenance stamping of all digital creations within a collaborative human-AI workflow. Every artifact produced — images, videos, documents, code, data files, compositions — receives a cryptographic provenance token (NFT) at creation time, without requiring user action. These tokens are NOT speculative assets but PROVENANCE RECEIPTS: proof of creation, authorship, timestamp, and collaborative lineage. Tokens are stored in a four-faced pocketbook (medial/lateral/dorsal/ventral) that functions simultaneously as: a game inventory (skins, cosmetics), a legal deed registry (car titles, property deeds), an art gallery (prints, originals, editions), and an identity stream (the weave of everything you've made). The cryptocurrency layer serves as the OUTSIDE FACE of the organism — the novel fermenter that transcends the internal weave into external value.
field: Computer Science — Digital Provenance, NFT Architecture, Collaborative Authorship, Identity Systems

the_problem.current_state: Digital creations have NO automatic provenance. Images generated in AI sessions vanish. Art made collaboratively has no proof of who contributed what. Game skins are platform-locked. Car deeds are paper. Music has no automatic royalty tracking. Every creation exists in a provenance vacuum.
what_gets_lost: 15 images generated this session — exist only on local disk, no provenance chain
4 videos generated — no record of the prompts, iterations, or collaborative process
904 JSON data files — no unified registry of when each was created or by whom
every email, every note, every sketch — born without a birth certificate
the_problem.the_cost: Creators cannot prove what they made. Collaborators cannot prove what they contributed. Provenance is reconstructed after the fact, if at all. The creation moment — the most important moment — is the least documented.

invention.core_claim: Automatic provenance stamping at creation time, stored in a four-faced pocketbook, with the cryptocurrency layer serving as the external face of an internal identity weave.

auto_stamp.what: Every digital artifact receives a provenance token at the moment of creation
auto_stamp.how: SHA-256 hash of content + timestamp + author(s) + tool + prompt/input + parent artifacts
auto_stamp.when: AUTOMATICALLY — no user action required. The stamp is part of the creation process, not an afterthought.
auto_stamp.stored_where: locally in the pocketbook (medial face) AND optionally on-chain (ventral face)
auto_stamp.what_it_proves: WHO made it, WHEN they made it, WHAT tools they used, WHAT inputs led to it, WHAT other artifacts it descends from

claims.claim: A system for automatic provenance stamping comprising: (a) a creation interceptor that captures metadata at the moment of artifact creation; (b) a hash generator that produces a cryptographic fingerprint of the artifact plus its creation context; (c) a token minter that creates a provenance token (NFT) from the fingerprint; (d) a four-faced pocketbook that stores the token across medial, lateral, dorsal, and ventral faces.
The system of claim 1, wherein the provenance token includes: creator identity, timestamp, tool used, input/prompt, parent artifacts, and collaborative contribution breakdown.

The system of claim 1, wherein the same token architecture represents heterogeneous asset types including but not limited to: art prints, property deeds, academic credentials, transaction receipts, and identity fragments.

A method for identity construction through token weaving, wherein: (a) each creation adds a provenance token to the creator's identity stream; (b) the aggregate pattern of all tokens constitutes the creator's verifiable identity; (c) the identity can be verified without revealing individual token contents (zero-knowledge).

A four-faced digital pocketbook comprising: (a) a medial face for private tokens visible only to the holder; (b) a lateral face for tokens shared with peers and collaborators; (c) a dorsal face for the complete temporal lineage of all tokens; (d) a ventral face for tokens published to the world or listed for exchange.

The system of claim 1, wherein the cryptocurrency layer serves as the external fermentation of internal creation, transforming raw artifacts into transferable value tokens without altering the internal identity weave.

A method for collaborative provenance tracking in human-AI workflows, wherein both human and AI contributions are captured, attributed, and tokenized at creation time, preserving the full collaborative lineage.

The system of claim 5, wherein the four-faced pocketbook implements a Klein fold such that the medial face generates the ventral face (private keys derive public identity) and the dorsal face IS the ventral face (history is the portfolio).
